title: Shortcuts
description: Set how to start, stop, and cancel a dictation. Changes are saved automatically.
global.label: Global shortcut
global.hint: Click the box and press the combination (modifiers + key).
activation.label: Activation mode
activation.hint.toggle: Press once to start and again to stop.
activation.hint.pushToTalk: Records only while the shortcut is held.
activation.option.toggle: Toggle — press to start, press to stop
activation.option.pushToTalk: Push to talk — records while held
cancel.label: Cancel shortcut
cancel.hint: Discards the recording without transcribing. Only active during recording — otherwise the key stays free for other apps.
